text: រីករាយដែលបានជួប
text_alt: សប្បាយចិត្តដែលបានជួប
literal: Khmer has no everyday formula for this; both forms belong to the polite register
provenance: Smyth, Colloquial Cambodian (Routledge); Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977);ipa=km-analysis

text: អ្នកឈ្មោះអ្វី?
យើងធ្វើដំណើរជាមួយគ្នា
នេះជាមិត្តរបស់ខ្ញុំ
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977);ipa=km-analysis

text: អ្នកមកពីណា?
សុខសប្បាយជាទេ?
literal: 'are you well?' -- the ordinary Khmer greeting-question, not a health enquiry
provenance: Huffman, Modern Spoken Cambodian (Yale, 1970); Smyth, Colloquial Cambodian (Routledge);ipa=km-analysis

text: ខ្ញុំជាអ្នកទេសចរណ៍
provenance: Ministry of Tourism Khmer-language wording (ទេសចរណ៍); Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977);ipa=km-analysis

text: នេះជាប្តីរបស់ខ្ញុំ
text_alt: នេះជាប្រពន្ធរបស់ខ្ញុំ
literal: first form says husband, second says wife; Khmer has no word covering both
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977);ipa=km-analysis

text: នេះជាកូនស្រីរបស់ខ្ញុំ
text_alt: នេះជាកូនប្រុសរបស់ខ្ញុំ
literal: first form says daughter, second says son
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977);ipa=km-analysis

text: ខ្ញុំធ្វើដំណើរម្នាក់ឯង
